categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Zhongyin Fashion Co., Ltd. primarily operates in fashion product design with a focus on footwear design and pattern design for various consumer goods. The company also provides supply chain integration services and has recently expanded into brand operation and cultural tourism services. Its business model includes design services, supply chain integration, footwear production, and brand operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a scalable, modular design process with a large team of designers capable of producing nearly 10,000 footwear design styles annually. It integrates advanced design techniques including 3D printing and temperature-sensitive breathable shoe technology. The supply chain integration involves quality control, production supervision, and logistics management to ensure design realization. The company also invests in intelligent production bases to enhance manufacturing capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international mid-to-mass market footwear brands, notably the Polish brand CCC and other well-known shoe enterprises. The company serves footwear manufacturers, brand owners, and trading companies, focusing on fast fashion and mass-market segments. Its markets span both domestic China and overseas, with a significant portion of revenue from exports.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province, China, a major footwear industry cluster. It operates production bases in Wenzhou and Xinjiang and has subsidiaries in Shanghai, Hangzhou, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. Its sales are predominantly international, with over 80% of revenue from overseas markets, including Central and Eastern Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Zhongyin Fashion operates primarily in the mid-to-upstream segments of the footwear supply chain, focusing on design and supply chain integration. It provides design services and organizes production through external manufacturers or its own production bases, ensuring design outcomes are realized in finished products. The company is not a pure manufacturer but integrates design with production and brand operation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes strengthening its R&D and design teams, expanding design capabilities into new product categories such as pattern design, and enhancing supply chain integration. It plans to build a one-stop designer resource sharing platform integrating intelligent design and manufacturing. The company is also developing its own brand operations and exploring new retail and marketing channels, including online platforms and live streaming.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of design services, supply chain integration services, footwear production, and brand operation sales. Design services are sold either as pre-designed styles for client selection or customized designs. Supply chain integration involves organizing production and selling finished products to clients. Brand operation revenue comes from self-produced or outsourced products sold primarily online.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position as a specialized, large-scale footwear design service provider with a rare capacity for mass, fast-fashion design. Competitors include internal design departments of brand footwear companies, small design studios, independent designers, and ODM manufacturers with limited design capabilities. Zhongyin's scale, efficiency, and supply chain integration provide a competitive advantage in the fast-fashion footwear design market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 358 million, a 27% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 33.2 million. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.16 billion, with equity of RMB 983 million. The company experienced a decline in production volume and profitability due to global economic challenges but continues to invest in R&D and brand development. It maintains a stable asset base and is expanding new business segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Zhongyin Fashion differentiates itself through its core design capability, offering fast, scalable, and trend-sensitive footwear design services that meet the demands of fast fashion. Its integrated supply chain services ensure design concepts are effectively translated into commercial products. The company’s geographic location in a major footwear cluster and its extensive supplier network enhance its ability to deliver quality and speed. Its innovation in functional footwear technology and expansion into brand operation further strengthen its market position.
